stack.routing: React Router 7 (HashRouter: works from any static folder)
stack.tests: Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom); headless Edge/Chrome smoke test

data_pipeline: evidence-sources.json names every committed file the dashboard may read (30 files + readiness/*.json + 65 Mermaid sources)
scripts/sync-evidence.mjs copies them byte-for-byte into public/evidence/ and writes manifest.json (SHA-256, git blob at HEAD, last commit); only files committed at HEAD are copied
src/evidence/loader.ts fetches each file, verifies its SHA-256 against the manifest, parses it, and records missing/invalid/mismatched datasets

src/evidence/model.ts builds typed datasets, recounts every total from detailed records and cross-checks it against recorded summaries; a missing dataset yields null (an "evidence unavailable" state), never zero
pages read only the model; nothing writes back to the repository

layers.src/evidence: contracts (types.ts), guards (check.ts), loader, model builder, React context
layers.src/lib: status vocabulary, formatting, table filter/sort/paginate/CSV, graph neighbourhoods, URL-state hooks
layers.src/components: layout, UI primitives, charts, controls (table, drawer, filters), graph canvas, Mermaid view
layers.tests: evidence, missing-data, table, graph and page tests

security: production Content-Security-Policy: default-src self, no inline scripts, no external origins
no network calls beyond the dashboard origin; no telemetry; no fonts or CDNs
Mermaid in strict mode without HTML labels
COBOL source paths shown as text, never fetched (restricted source is not committed)
